item.title: How to get a REAL ID in Arkansas and not have to pay the $45 fee at the airport
item.description: Arkansans can get a REAL ID at any of the state's revenue offices with the appropriate documentation for $10 or $40, and those without one will need to pay a $45 fee to TSA to board a flight starting February 1st.

item.title: Arkansas state offices to remain closed on Friday due to road conditions
item.description: Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders has announced that state office buildings in Arkansas will remain closed on Friday due to hazardous road conditions caused by a winter storm, with only critical state operations remaining open and employees urged to telework if possible.

item.title: Central Arkansas schools remain closed as ice delays cleanup efforts
item.description: Schools in central Arkansas have been closed due to dangerous snow and ice conditions, with administrators monitoring the situation closely before deciding when students can return to classrooms.
